spec.basis: Andrew, 19 Oct 2026: "COMPETED", in answer to the milestone staying at 16 of 20 until VMS18 and VMS19 are set up in position. T0158 was already complete for its first five boards (VMS13-17); complete is pressed again so the page counts the seven received (VMS13-19) as installed.

delivery/T0158.note: Came in 16 Oct 2026 for Monday 19 Oct: VMS13 Senior 1191957 rego EN3803 (Andrew wrote 1191657; the contract line reads 1191957, one digit apart, to be checked on the plate); VMS14 Junior 1201864 rego TD98VJ; VMS15 Senior 1211348 rego ER9217; VMS16 Senior 1211376 rego ES3211; VMS17 Senior 1211364 rego ER9410. Contract 9961265 lines 32, 34, 35, 37, 39. Regos as Andrew read them off the boards, 16 Oct. VMS19 arrived 19 Oct 2026: Premiair Hire sub-hire, fleet 487T, rego TE02H0 (contract 9961265 line 25). VMS18 arrived 19 Oct 2026: Premiair Hire sub-hire, fleet 472T, rego TE58GZ (contract 9961265 line 24).

history.note: Andrew, 18 Oct: "They are here already onsite. They turned up friday". Dated by the regos he read off these five boards on site, Fri 16 Oct 12:09 AEST.
